row.notes: Called by Game_F1DataFeedSystem_UpdateCar. Per car index (< g 0x146ce86dc, car = g 0x146ce86e0[i]): copies the 4x4 matrix arg3 into [car+0x558]+0x190/+0x290/+0x1d0, tyre temps (arg8[0x25..0x28]+273.15) into [car+0x580]+0x70..+0x88, wheel transforms, progress record [[this+0xe0]+0x38][i] (+0x30..+0xc0, PROGRESS setUnmodifiedProgressLap log); finally sets result row [[this+0xf0]+0x148][i] to eRetired (0x307) or eActive (2) with the SESSION-RESULT log. Better name: Sess_DataFeed_ApplyVehicleState (bound record keeps its name).
